M1 counter is one output dot product with 64 inputs, not a 64 by 64 array.
Counter includes signed selection, bucket routing, registered reduction and temporal count; excludes SNG/comparator, SRAM, nonlinear and restoration.
Counter has clock-enable/data-hold only, not actual ICG; idle test keeps clock running.
Restore already includes bucket shift/reduction, coefficient multiplication, rounding and sign restore. Do not price bucket reduction twice.
Restore idle test keeps clock running; its pipeline may shift bubbles. ICG plus operand isolation is a new unmeasured design assumption.
500 MHz dynamic extrapolation assumes fixed voltage and approximately unchanged per-cycle activity. Added pipelining, gate sizing and CTS costs remain unpriced.
B7/T128 and M8 activity power are not measured. Area-ratio / sample-count power scaling is a separately labelled proxy.
SRAM values are Liberty/LEF extraction, not a new PT or silicon run. Clock-tree, Q routing, mux, CDC and CIM modifications are excluded.
No complete-chip area or energy is available. Subtotals must not be labelled complete chip values.
